description: Builds a 4OVER4 print kit for a campaign or launch, one real product per piece (business cards, flyers, banners, signs, stickers); use it when someone plans a promotion or an opening and wants several printed pieces. For one product use show_products. Requires the goal; productTypes names the exact pieces. Returns one product per piece with slug and reason, plus a short plan. Customer phrases: "grand opening kit", "business cards, postcards and flyers for my real estate business".
